evidence.name: Screen field: Restore link background fill
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Restore link background fill" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Restore link background fill
sections.description: Adds a colored background block behind the restore link text. Most restore links sit on the plain header with no fill, so the default is none — leave it unset for the usual text-only look. Set a color only if you want a chip or pill behind the link, then shape it with the opacity and corner-radius fields below.
